side_effects.context: **Side effects / reviewer note:** No API change. Comparison is now numeric, so any code relying on the previous incorrect lexicographic ordering will see different results (intended). The registry flaky test `test_manifest_fetch_after_cold_start` still depends on `pytest-rerunfailures` (`--reruns 2`) to pass on retry; not addressed in this change.

summary: Fix: `pkgver/version.py:19-24` – `compare_versions` compared the normalized string forms lexicographically (`str(Version(a)) < str(Version(b))`), so `"1.10.0" < "1.9.0"` (lexicographically).
